last_decision.summary: Stay flat on GOOG.NAS. It also verified the measurement-alternative private-stake book rose $35.2B to $64.1B during 2025 with $45.6B remeasured on unobservable inputs (a4c7919f6aeaee02) - confirming large non-cash OI&E swings as a structural feature, not a one-off. The unresolved dispute persists: Q2 capex $44.9B exceeded Q2 OCF $39.1B, $49.6B was raised in common plus 6.25% mandatory convertible preferred, and the $195-205B FY26 capex guide still rests on unverified publisher summaries. The decisive number - Q3 Cloud segment operating income versus the depreciation wave - remains unfiled; the earnings date is still not 8-K-confirmed. The tape gives no edge: fresh quote 337.51/337.56, drift lower within the 333-351 Bollinger band (live packet), RSI ~48.5, negative MACD histogram, ATR ~7.9 - not the decisive volume-confirmed close below the dated 200-session mean (~339.26) that the invalidation trigger requires. Holding cash remains the correct resolution of an unresolved, primary-evidenced dispute.
last_decision.thesis: Watch stance carried forward, now strengthened by primary-source verification of the 10-K baseline. Verified facts cut both ways: demand is real and accelerating (revenue $402.8B FY25 +15.1%, Cloud margin ~24% and doubled, Services operating income $139.4B, $513.9B Cloud backlog per prior filings), while the capital cycle is verified as well (2025 capex $91.4B, +74% YoY, with explicit management language that 2026 investment will significantly increase and that depreciation, energy and network costs will rise with AI serving - 76dee2db466cdecb). The equity/hybrid funding choice is verified: $49.6B net proceeds including $19.0B of 6.25% cumulative mandatory convertible preferred plus a $40B ATM, expressly for AI/compute capex (280f6fb11eb215ec). Earnings-quality caveat is now structural: the $64.1B measurement-alternative book with unobservable inputs means GAAP EPS can whipsaw on mark reversals without cash effect (a4c7919f6aeaee02). Macro is unchanged: DGS10 5.10% vs 2Y 4.77% is term-premium/real-rate pressure, not a policy signal (DFEDTARU 4.0%); VIX ~20 and HY spreads 3.31% show repricing, not distress (c82957760f866e9c, 4c6c610ef1195bcb, 8105bdd1c466d7ce, b9d7d8ce511c320e) - so there is no rate-relief catalyst and any upside must be earnings-carried. Today's secondary news (BofA Cloud/TPU upside note, tech-led selling on AI fears, UK Cloud outage, Meta Oct-21 print) is thesis-neutral pending primary verification. Neither the bull nor bear case is falsified; the falsification point is the Q3-26 10-Q segment data. Six hours is an ordinary minimum; paying for either hypothesis pre-print remains uneconomic.
last_decision.countercase: Bulls argue the show-me discount is the entry: the bar is reset low after the ~6% post-Q2 drop despite strong Cloud results, BofA flags Q3 Cloud/TPU upside, Cloud margin has already nearly doubled once and the $513.9B backlog (over half convertible within 24 months) verifies contracted demand; the 200-session mean has held at ~339 with only a -3.1% 20-session pullback inside a +35% 12-month trend, credit is calm, and waiting forfeits gap optionality if the Q3 print discloses Cloud margin absorbing the depreciation wave. Bears counter that at a 5.10% 10Y and 5.43% 30Y with no rate-relief catalyst, ~$200B capex funded by equity, mandatory converts and serial dilution before ROI is proven compresses ROIC and multiples; the $77.4B Q2 unrealized OI&E mark could reverse and cut GAAP EPS; peer AI-financing fears (CoreWeave) and Meta's Oct-21 print could de-rate the whole complex before Alphabet reports; and today's drift to 337.5 with a weak 0.78x-volume bounce shows no demand confirmation. Both cases remain credible; neither is confirmed by primary Q3 evidence.
last_decision.invalidation: The watch stance resolves to action on specific events: (1) Q3-26 10-Q filing - extract Cloud segment operating income versus the nearly doubled depreciation run-rate, any filed capex guidance replacing the unverified $195-205B publisher figure, diluted share count, and like-for-like backlog growth; (2) earnings date confirmed via an official 8-K rather than social posts; (3) verified scope, duration and issuer statement on the Oct-20 Google Cloud outage; (4) Meta's Oct-21 results as the hyperscaler capex read-across; (5) price evidence - a decisive close below the dated 200-session mean (~339.26 on the Oct-19 series) on above-average volume, or a range breakout above ~351 with Cloud-positive primary confirmation. The current 337.51/337.56 quote sits marginally below that dated reference but the live packet's 60-session window yields no 200-day calculation, so treat the trigger as requiring the dated-series comparison plus volume confirmation; today's drift is routine range movement. A close action would require an owned position whose thesis a new filing or verified event specifically invalidates; no position exists. Full-filing certification remains incomplete - disclosed and owner-authorized for this demo experiment - which further justifies no directional exposure before primary Q3 numbers.

last_decision.thesis: Hold on SP500 is a portfolio-level decision, unchanged across five prior approved holds. Verified standing facts from this packet's sources: Fed target range 3.75-4.00% held through 20 Oct with zero change over twenty observations (ca9825810a4cd9ad, 3e832896e101d9fb); T10Y2Y at 0.38 after +0.13 over 20 sessions and T10Y3M at 0.88 after +0.05 (191b222125fce2d3, 76dcfb6a1bf9cd5b) - a curve consistent with tightening still partially priced; HY OAS 3.29% after +0.63pp/20 sessions but -2bp on the latest day (6d0922dcd63ffee8), against BBB 1.08% (60f3122db00d70b3) and NFCI -0.499 (5b7a7deea2eaf293): mild credit drift, no systemic strain; claims 199k (d053aab6f5791362), unemployment 4.2% (f16462f199348f84); Brent $126.55 stale to 14 Oct (743e142646c4773c). The falsifiable question is unchanged: does the shared global-tightening factor keep compressing long-duration index multiples, or does range trade persist with intact labour and calm aggregate credit? The 21 Oct CPI print is the scheduled test distinguishing an energy-only rise (escalation weakens) from verified second-round effects (escalation strengthens); the 20 Oct ONS labour release arrived only as unverified single-publisher BBC reporting, directionally softening the second-round hawkish branch without resolving it. The quote's continued drift toward the 20-SMA is diagnostic of neither hypothesis. No order is warranted; any future conversion additionally requires fresh quotes, measured CFD costs and decomposed policy expectations.
last_decision.countercase: Strongest case against holding: the short-side branch is half-formed - the index sits below its 20-session SMA with a negative MACD histogram, HY OAS widened materially over 20 sessions while the Fed holds a restrictive 3.75-4.00% range, and waiting through the 21 Oct CPI forgoes trend if discount-rate compression accelerates. The strongest case against a short is equally concrete: the multi-session intraday recovery (7672.3 to 7724.1 across three decisions today) cuts against the stress narrative, HY eased on the latest print, BBB and NFCI show no systemic strain, and the committee established that VIX, HY OAS and volume signals form one correlated cluster, not independent confirmations - shorting now risks expressing a single unresolved event hours before its scheduled test. The strongest case for a long: calm credit, 199k claims, and the index reclaiming the 50-SMA suggest the compression line is overdone. Rebuttal: the long branch requires the 10Y below ~4.9% and HY under ~3.0%, neither observed - the latest delivered long-end print is 5.43% (1b7389fe70fca0f3) - and UK CPI risk remains against a 3.1% base. A flat GBP 1,500 demo book forgoes learning, but the mandate's patient-thesis requirement and a catalyst within hours outweigh that; a six-hour-plus hold is an ordinary minimum, never a timer.
last_decision.invalidation: Hold converts to a directional file only with specific source-backed resolution: (1) the 21 Oct UK CPI print - confirmed second-round wage/price effects escalate the global-tightening branch; an energy-only rise with soft labour weakens it and, corroborated by ONS detail, narrows the short-side case further; (2) HY OAS sustained above ~3.5-3.6% with repeated heavy-volume breadth losses would justify researching a short index file; (3) the 10Y below ~4.9% with HY back under ~3.0% and index volume normalising would close the rate-compression line and justify researching a long file; (4) readable OIS/SEP decomposition separating expected policy from term premium. New price levels alone resolve only pricing objections and never trigger trades. Any conversion requires fresh-session quotes, measured spread and a full holding-cost budget; the instrument is a price-only CFD with swap fields as metadata (56826bfee225dbfa). Uncertified full-filing diligence may justify continued holding even where a directional thesis matures.
